text:
marta: Heads-up — support asked if we can add a limited 'debug extract' mode to pull redacted request/response pairs for customer investigations. They want an easy way to export a small batch to an S3 path with TTL. Thoughts?

saif: Quick Q — is this different from existing inspect mode?

marta: Yes — inspect shows ephemeral view in console. This would be an export that support can hand to customer (after approval) for replaying issues. We need strict consent + PII rules.

devon: Also need legal sign-off. Exporting even redacted data is sensitive. What fields do we allow? We should avoid free-text user content unless we've applied strong pseudonymization. :lock:​

chen: UX idea: a per-tenant toggle in Console with a 1-click export flow that records approver, reason, and automatically attaches audit-id. Exports should be for a specified time window and capped to N requests.

marta: propose constraints: max 500 reqs, TTL of object 24h, server-side KMS encryption, include audit metadata and a checksum, and automatic scrub run using deid heuristics before writing.

saif: Implementation-wise, runtime can stream through the existing redact pipeline then write ndjson to S3. We need a flag on the sampler to force full capture for those request ids. But we must ensure this doesn't bypass sampling or PII redaction.

devon: We need an allowlist of customers who can enable exports and audit hooks that notify security and legal. Also require the export to zero out any tokens that look like secrets (auth tokens, credit-card like patterns).

leo: oncall-bot: notify #eng-oncall Export job started by marta for tenant=acme-corp window=2026-03-18T02:00Z-2026-03-18T03:00Z items=120 audit_id=aud_12345

marta: example config we sketched: ```yaml
export_mode:
  enabled: true
  max_items: 500
  ttl_hours: 24
  encrypt: KMS:projects/redwood/keys/exports
  scrub_profile: "export-default-v1"
  require_approver: true
```

chen: Good. On the Console side we should show a preflight check that warns about PII risk and requires approver name + justification. Also a grayed-out export if tenant hasn't accepted terms.

saif: Perf note — pulling from cold storage logs could hit hot path. Suggest we implement export by scanning our sample-store index (not full request DB) and do controlled parallelism with backpressure. Add circuit-breaker for overall throughput.

devon: I'll draft language for legal consent and the minimal data fields allowed. We should default to pseudonymize user_text -> <USER_TEXT_HASH> and include original length and language stats.

marta: Action items: saif to prototype runtime hook + scrub pipeline (ETA 1 week), chen to mock Console flow and approval UX (ETA 5 days), devon to get legal checklist and scrub rules (ETA 3 days). I'll file RFC once we have sketches.

leo: :thumbsup: tagging me on the RFC for oncall runbook. Also we should add a telemetry event for export_request.created and export_request.completed with latency + item_count.

marta: agreed. we'll keep exports off by default and gated via support/enterprise. Thanks all — will follow up in RFC.
